scenarioTitle: Filling gaps in an existing plan
description: Half the positions already have their lecturers and are locked; the run only fills what is missing. This is the common case in practice — a department revisits its plan in September — and it is the one where locked assignments consume capacity that the repair and improvement passes are then forbidden to reclaim.
